extra_quotes: The optimization is performed in a metasystem consisting of five 1D metasurfaces (i.e. metalines) with 6µm separations.
For all optimizations, the 2.5D variational FDTD solver of Lumerical Mode Solution (varFDTD) is used for structural modeling.
The verified results using mesh accuracy 2 has small differences with optimized ones, which is shown in Fig. 3(c).

Because of the large discrepancy between varFDTD results and 3D FDTD verifications, which leads to the degraded performance of the switch design, the last 20 iterations are performed using 3D FDTD for structural modeling.
3D FDTD is definitely a better choice for performing the optimizations, however, the simulation time is a big barrier.
